provisional_label: provisional — no paper claim audit available

C1.supported: Frozen low102 functionality, held-out adaptation exclusion, real detail proposals, fit qualification preservation for three rejected scales, and rollback are verified.
C1.not_supported: No accepted adaptation or demonstrated mitigation of regression with improvement. Independent check is baseline identity after rollback, not updated-candidate generalization.

C2.interpretation: No formal candidate training, VAL, DEV, or new execution result exists; this is absent evidence, not measured downstream failure.

what_results_support: 189 source and 19222 frozen-input hashes match; 32 saved Jacobians pass independent reconstruction; first/last saved VJP and manual AdamW match exactly; 64 sampled low outputs match old DDIM; 192 raw controls reproduce exactly; all three fit scales retain 8/8 protected outputs, but none passes acceptance; retained state equals initialization.
what_results_dont_support: Useful accepted adaptation, check-pool generalization of an updated candidate, no-regression across unprotected strata, isolated causal benefit of protection, new execution certification, unguided VAL/DEV gain, or engineering full-chain completion.
missing_evidence: An accepted updated candidate meeting the frozen M1 gates
Independent check outcomes for an updated candidate
Formal 6000-update candidate and frozen VAL/DEV comparisons
Nonempty qualified protection evidence in complex strata and fit large-motion stratum
Per-task native67 execution and independent replay for the engineering chain
suggested_claim_revision: The bounded diagnostic preserved old low-dimensional sampling functionality and rejected all three insufficient proposals while preserving fitted qualified outputs; it restored the original state and did not establish adaptation, generalization, or execution gains.
next_experiments_needed: Close this frozen bounded run without gate changes or further local hyperparameter sweeps.

Under a separately versioned engineering protocol, integrate static obstacle planning, full-state 17-to-67 execution, native torque validation and independent replay, then dynamic waypoint tracking. Gains are not a prerequisite for that new engineering objective.
If learning is revisited, first test a mechanism-level parameterization with adequate endpoint authority; the saved normalized Jacobians suggest very weak detail-coordinate endpoint sensitivity.
review_limit: Saved-data verification only; no physics simulation, existing audit, optimizer.step, training, or resume invoked.
